# Accessibility follow-up\n\nThis PR collects follow-up items found during the post-merge review of the dark-neon UI and hero→services transition. It does not change runtime behavior — it documents targeted fixes and provides a place to track small, low-risk accessibility improvements.\n\nPlanned fixes:\n- Fix heading order in hero and sections (H1→H2→H3)\n- Adjust color contrast for hero overlay text and badges to meet WCAG AA\n- Verify mobile menu focus management and ensure Escape closes dialog\n- Add visible focus styles for interactive cards and tech tiles on keyboard navigation\n- Add ARIA labels or aria-labelledby to custom dialogs and overlays where missing\n\nValidation steps: run Lighthouse and axe/pa11y (CI or local) after changes.\n\nCo-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
